shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts __agent_eval__/run.mjs .gitignore; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | grep -i -E 'dropdown|menu|popup|button'

sed -n 1,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n "switcher\|renderSwitcher\|items\|size\|popupProps\|defaultSwitcherProps" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "icons installed" || echo "no icons pkg"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Icon 2>/dev/null | head

grep -n "SwitcherProps" -A6 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts | head -30; grep -n '"@gravity-ui/icons"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; grep -n "theme\|disabled\|selected" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -iE '^(Pencil|Copy|TrashBin|ArrowUpFromSquare|Ellipsis|ChevronDown|Plus)\.'

rm -rf dist && (ls node_modules/playwright* node_modules/puppeteer* 2>/dev/null | head -3; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null) ; echo "---"; git status --short
